minutes.headline: Water commissioners delayed a planned per-bill line item charge and agreed to hire outside communications help.
minutes.summary: The commissioners approved prior minutes, made annual appointments, and heard that the planned line item charge starting July 1 is on hold because of project unknowns. The chair announced he will step down as chair, with reorganization on the next agenda. The board discussed continuing a communications consultant's services, and then adjourned.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the May 16th special meeting

budget_items.topic: Line item charge on water bills
budget_items.what_was_said: A planned line item charge, originally to begin with the July 1 billing cycle, will not start yet because project unknowns remain. A notice will be posted and a note put on the bill.
A member proposed continuing the consultant's services for content and resident communication. No cost was stated.

decisions.decision: The line item charge will not start next billing cycle; the board will wait until the project unknowns are resolved and post a notice online and on the bill.
Reorganization of the board will be on the next meeting agenda; the chair will step down as chair until the next election.
Board members expressed support for continuing communications services with Capital Strategic Solutions; no formal vote was captioned.
